subject: Re: Pickup quote 80602 Munich to MUC on 2026-11-24
body:
Hi there,

Thanks for your request! We’d be happy to collect your freight in Munich and deliver it to the air export warehouse at MUC.

Our all-in price is 243.29 EUR. Pickup time: 15 hours. The offer is valid until 22 Nov 2026 02:37 UTC.

Offer reference: TRK-11302. No booking is needed.

Best regards,
Isarwelle Spedition

classification.reasoning: The trucker replies to our pickup quote request with an all-in price, pickup time, validity, and offer reference.
